notes.title: We hope you’re ready for some ‘Tricky Treats’!
notes.content:
[h2]Happy Halloween!🎃[/h2] 
It’s the season of all things scary! You probably already know what that means, don’t you? That’s right, it’s time to bring out the Halloween Bricks once again! We hope you don’t get scared easily, because we’ve prepared an eerie challenge for all of you to take on!

[h2]Can you create the spookiest building?[/h2]
Have you ever wanted to build your own haunted mansion? Or perhaps you’ve been meaning to construct a creepy tower? Well, now would be the right time, because we’re challenging all of you to create a spooky building in Tricky Towers! Do you think you can build the spookiest one?

It’s time to get creative and of course, creativity should not go unrewarded! That’s why we will be selecting the creepiest constructions. The architects behind these constructions will win the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/667750/Indie_Friends_Pack/]Indie Friends DLC[/url] to dress up their wizards in style for Halloween!

To participate, you’ll just need to make a screenshot of your creation and share it with us on Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, or the Tricky Towers subreddit. Happy building!

[h2]Sinister sale![/h2]
Want to join in on the challenge, but don’t own Tricky Towers yet? Well, you’re in luck! Tricky Towers is currently 60% off! Grab it while you can.

For now, [b]Happy Halloween[/b] from all of us at WeirdBeard and we can’t wait to see your creations!

notes.title: A Magical Christmas with Tricky Towers!
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Brickmas![/h1]
Tricky Towers is all about building magical towers with an assortment of different colorful bricks! For this season, the one to go to are the Christmas bricks, complete with cheerful lights and a bit of snow on top! Of course, you can choose which ever you want. If you are looking for even more variety in your tower builds, be sure to check out our Gem, Galaxy, Holographic & Candy brick packs in the DLC store!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/7bba3399f285ef4aa2f553bc21a5ca6b07372e63.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/7bba3399f285ef4aa2f553bc21a5ca6b07372e63.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Christmas Discounts![/h2]
Do you have a magician friend that could use a nice Christmas gift? Turn on your virtual fireplace, meet each other online and get together to build some amazing towers! [b]Tricky Towers is -66% off[/b] during the Steam Winter Sale that runs until January 5th 2021!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/437920/Tricky_Towers/

[h2]The brick does not fall far from the tree.. [/h2]
If you are a competitive wizard that’s looking for a real challenge, check out our December challenge! [b]Can you build a tower in Tricky Towers in the shape of a Christmas Tree?[/b] Be sure to share it with us on our Social Media pages, such as Twitter (link to http://www.twitter.com/weirdbeardgames).

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/be0fab7ea15c8cb9f8c88bbaa8ff08f41f6d0046.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/7bba3399f285ef4aa2f553bc21a5ca6b07372e63.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Time for a Terrifying Tricky Towers Halloween!
notes.content:
Halloween is almost here, and with it a [b]60% sale[/b] for Tricky Towers! The perfect chance to get the game if you don’t own it yet, or maybe it’ll be the ideal gift for a friend?

And what if you want to get spooky while stacking your towers? Well that’s what the [i]Halloween Bricks[/i] are all about!
 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/d0516b75097a9469df17de5452378df1dfd9b8b6.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/d0516b75097a9469df17de5452378df1dfd9b8b6.gif[/img][/url]

The free Halloween Bricks start out like normal bricks, but when you place them they awaken into their true form! There are bats, pumpkins and spiders to give your tower a creepy Halloween vibe – and we think they’re super cute too. If you really like them, you can use them all year round – Halloween never needs to end in Tricky Towers!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/ee95c25c43b2cf0fa4c57267e25cebdb7d8e54f5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/ee95c25c43b2cf0fa4c57267e25cebdb7d8e54f5.png[/img][/url]


[h1]Have a great Halloween everyone![/h1]

notes.title: Spooky v-sync update!
notes.content:
[h1]V-Sync option added![/h1]
As computers have gotten faster, some of our wizards have run into trouble playing Tricky Towers alongside other activities like watching video online. If you were one of these unfortunate people, today’s update brings a new graphical option which may help!

Try turning on V-Sync by going to Settings, then use the right arrow to get to where you set your graphical options. There you should see the new V-Sync button – just check that and hit apply!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/96ef270f8923951a00628639f0a507c561cc3c53.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/96ef270f8923951a00628639f0a507c561cc3c53.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also improved controller support for MacOS. We hope this will resolve issues some players were having.

[b]Don’t forget your Halloween bricks![/b] We’re less than a month away, so it’s the perfect time to try out the free Halloween Brick Pack if you haven’t already! These bricks are decorated with pleasing pumpkins, beautiful bats, spooky spiders and cute cobwebs!

[i][b]Happy stacking, wonderful wizards![/b][/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/51dcde74ecf41cb770f1cc71e5aaebeddaccbaf0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25546228/51dcde74ecf41cb770f1cc71e5aaebeddaccbaf0.jpg[/img][/url]

[*] The other wizards are probably lucky that [b]Octodad[/b] isn’t using all his arms for building!
[*] Have the last laugh with [b]Lethal League[/b]’s Candy Man!
[*] And last but not least, The Last of the Order from [b]TowerFall[/b] puts aside her bow to build some magical towers!
[/list]
https://youtu.be/K0-MUhc29Kk
You receive a [b]stacking 10% discount[/b] on the DLC for each one of the games above that you already own, and Tricky Towers itself will have a 60% discount!

Also we fixed some localisation issues and improved Steam connectivity in update 1.6.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/667750/Indie_Friends_Pack/

notes.title: St. Patrick brings Gem Bricks and some fixes
notes.content:
It is almost St. Patrick's Day and that is why we have some shiny new gem bricks available!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25546228/2ab609c87f4211d104e1491dbf0c05c214f76e32.png[/img]

And that is not all, we’re also pushing out some improvements to the game:
* The matchmaking algorithm is updated to search for other games while waiting for other players.
* We've updated to Unity 5.5 which improves the frame rate.
* Removed a bug that let players in friends games get XP.
* Improved Turkish Localisation.

For more details on updates, make sure to check the changelog.
http://steamcommunity.com/app/437920/discussions/0/152391246765548587/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/570363/

notes.title: Christmas update!
notes.content:
Tricky Towers brings Christmas bricks to the game! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25546228/440e0be86916c331f33a9f7196a01b4f08ff3afe.png[/img]

We've made sure to add some Christmas decorations to the game. Now when hosting a friendly tournament after a lovely Christmas dinner, you can maintain the magical holiday spirit! 

And that's not all, the update also includes; 
[list]
[*]Added option to disable all explanations 
[*]Idle players are now automatically removed from online games 
[*]Added invite friend option to public games 
[*]Fixed bug where puzzle sometimes didn't have a base
[/list]

Happy Holidays everyone!

notes.title: Free expansion for Tricky Towers!
notes.content:
It's high time for some healthy wizardry competition between friends and family and what better timing than releasing this [b]free expansion[/b] for the Holidays.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7HjQuUR6Ceg]Watch the new trailer[/url]

As well as the usual bug squashing and UX improvements, we've released a free local and online multiplayer [b]tournament system with a printable party pack[/b]!
 
The Tricky Towers expansion includes;
[list]
[*] Local and online tournament mode; play multiple rounds to find out who is the ultimate wizard
[*] Endless single player puzzle leaderboard mode
[*] Weekly and monthly leaderboards for the most fanatical wizards out there
[*] New achievements
[*] [url=http://www.trickytowers.com/tournamentkit.php]Printable tournament pack [/url];
[list]
[*] Tricky Towers Tournament schedule; print out and hang on your living room wall to keep track who has to play against whom
[*] Official rules of the Tricky Towers Tournament Cup
[*] Printable wizard hats to help you dress up and impress your rivals during matches
[*] 3D model of the Tricky Towers Super Cup which you can print out and give to the winner of the tournament!
[/list]
[*] language select and key binding
[/list]
[img]http://www.trickytowers.com/img/tournamentKitWeb.png[/img]
 
Cheers,
Team WeirdBeard

notes.title: 1.12 Update
notes.content:
Hi everybody, we're back with another update. We've had the time to thoroughly test all possible controller combinations we have laying around the office and ironed out all the bugs we could find. 

This update includes:

[list]
[*] Xbox one & 360 controllers issue with rotating bricks is fixed
[*] Friend games are now completely private, so no random players can join 
[*] If you join a public game of a friend through the steam overlay, you now get XP
[/list]


That's it for this update, thanks again for all the feedback and suggestions, keep it coming!

- WeirdBeard

notes.title: 1.11 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we just pushed the first update for Tricky Towers. Thanks to everybody for the great feedback. We've been hard at work fixing some bugs, luckily all the kind and fun reactions have kept us going :)

Anyway, let's get to the important stuff, what did we fix:

[list]
[*] Xbox one controller is now supported on all platforms
[*] Issue where input from xbox one & 360 controllers got switched around is also fixed
[*] Improved stability of online play 
[/list]

We'll keep working to improve and add to the game, so if you have any feedback or suggestions, we'd love to hear it here in the discussions or let us know on Twitter or Facebook.

Have a great weekend and thanks for playing Tricky Towers!

- WeirdBeard
